title: MZ Problem with encouter effects vissustella

posts.author: tzartos
posts.body:
I cant make an enemy to chase me. for real i even used chat gpt plus and i cant make him chase me, not even see me... he wont even do anything other than move left and right from the custom movement programing. Is there anyone who can understand how this vissustella plug in works? i cant find anything on google and even chat gpt gives me so many codes none of them works. Lastly i used
<Encounter>
On note and on right side box i made a comment with
<Encounter>
Troop: 1
Range: 8
ResponseType: chase
Balloon: Exclamation
</Encounter>
Nothing works... i did so many stuff, i cant find any solution, if there is anyone who knows please tell me.
I even did other codes like only NOTE :
<Encounter: Troop 1, Range 6, ResponseType: chase, Balloon: Exclamation>

posts.author: Canned_Dinosaur
posts.body:
Hello there. Could you please read the
Support Template
and provide more information accordingly? It says
READ
in all caps with three exclamation marks for a reason.
So, as you may have understood by now, ChatGPT is not a good place to ask for support on things you know little about. LLMs such as ChatGPT are only useful for problem solving if you have the ability to critically examine the information you are fed.
So don't
.
Just don't
.
Never
.
Thank you.
Secondly, Visustella provides extensive wikis which list all the available note tags. After reading the template, please also provide information on which wikis you have referenced, if any.

posts.author: Akou
posts.body:
Encounter Effects VisuStella MZ
<- Wiki
​
I don't see any "
<Encounter>
" notetag here.
But:
Range -> <Alert Range: x>
Reponse -> <Alert Response: chase>
(You can also use
rush
,
flee
or
random
)
Ballon -> <Response Balloon: name>
You still have to look carefully at which notetag to put them in (Troop Name tag / Event Notetag / Event Page Comment Tags / Tileset / Map Notetag / etc).
Well, just look at the wiki and you will find what you need.
NB: You also need to have the
Core Engine
, placed above the Encounter Effect.
Spoiler:
Tier plugin
Tier 4
This plugin is a Tier 4 plugin. Place it under other plugins of lower tier value on your Plugin Manager list (ie: 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5).
This is to ensure that your plugins will have the best compatibility with the rest of the
VisuStella MZ
Plugin library.
Hope this helps you.
